newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Port conditions update - Bangladesh - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Bangladesh - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

CHITTAGONG, Dec 1 - All inward movements have been cancelled by the port authority. At 1200, local time Dec 1 a cyclone was centred at about 620 km south-west of Chittagong port. It is likely to intensify further and move in a north-easterly direction. Ports of Chittagong and Cox's Bazaar have been advised to keep hoisted danger signal no.7 and the port of Mongla to hoist danger signal no.5. as a precautionary measure due to cyclonic weather.
